children: Kyiv, Ukraine, October 28th, 2026, Chainwire

001k.bot has launched a promotion on USDT and BTC swaps in both directions: the service fee on USDT → BTC and BTC → USDT market swaps is 0%. The offer suits those who prefer to spread their BTC purchases across several transactions to avoid making decisions on emotion, as well as those who need to swap BTC back into USDT.

This format works especially well for those who prefer to buy BTC gradually rather than convert the full amount in one go. For example, $5,000 can be split into several transactions, with the timing of each next purchase left up to the user. Under the promotion, 001k.bot charges no service fee on these market swaps. The same terms apply when selling: if a user needs to move part of their funds from BTC back into stablecoins, no service fee is charged on that swap either.

Before confirming a transaction, the user sees the current rate, the service fee, and the final amount they will receive, so they can assess the swap terms in advance and compare them with other platforms.
This approach does not eliminate market risk or guarantee a better price or profit, but it makes it possible to spread the purchase over time and keep part of the funds in USDT.

"It's impossible to time the entry point, so the professional approach is to split the purchase into parts. We removed the service fee on USDT/BTC and BTC/USDT market swaps so that splitting a purchase doesn't create additional service costs," says Serhii Hutsu, brand ambassador at 001k.bot.

001k.bot also offers a breakdown of a historical BTC model that identifies the period from October 2026 to early February 2027 as a potential window for gradual accumulation. The model serves only as a reference point: it does not forecast an exact price or date for the low, and it does not guarantee a subsequent rise in BTC.
0% Service Fee Terms
The promotion applies to the 001k.bot service fee on USDT/BTC market swaps covered by the promotion terms in both directions: USDT → BTC and BTC → USDT.
The spread may be included in the quote. BTC withdrawals and Limit Order transactions are charged separately under the service's current terms.
Buying or selling BTC in a few steps

The offer is available in the 001k.bot Telegram and on the web platform. To buy, select the USDT/BTC swap, enter the amount, check the rate and the final amount of BTC, then confirm the transaction. To sell, the steps are the same: select the BTC/USDT swap, enter the amount, check the rate and the final amount of USDT, then confirm the transaction.

Purchased BTC is credited to the 001k.bot balance, where it can be kept or withdrawn to an external wallet via the Bitcoin network. Users who have already completed verification do not need to go through KYC again. New users need to create an account, complete KYC, and top up their balance with USDT or BTC.
Current promotion dates, the rate, and full terms are displayed right before the transaction is confirmed.
About 001k.bot

001k.bot is a crypto-financial platform designed for fast asset management, exchanges, and payments. It offers fast swaps at the best market rates, limit orders, off-chain transactions, secure asset storage, and a multi-level referral program.
Originally launched as a Telegram bot, 001k.bot is now available as a full-featured, independent web platform that works in any browser — no apps or messengers required.
